title: Hysab Kytab v1.0.7
message: Fixed direct APK install launch, added background download with system notification progress, and Gemini AI voice popup.
changelog: Native Android package installer launch with zero Sharing errors
System background downloading (can minimize app without interruption)
Live progress bar in Android notification drawer
Gemini AI style floating bottom sheet popup for long-press Home button
In-app dark voice listener with extended speaking timeouts
